text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — Wed release train window 10:00-12:00 PT. Need owners for each deploy slot, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Reply with 'I got <service>' or :thumbsup: if you can own. Please confirm any hard blockers or migrations ASAP.

Alex Rivera: I got inference-runtime (canary). Will run smoke and hold the canary lane. I can be on call 09:45-12:30 PT.

Raj Patel: I can take api-gateway. Heads up I have a brief calendar conflict 10:30-10:45 PT — prefer gateway at 11:00-11:20.

Jordan Lee: I'll backstop app-config and feature-flag rollout. Prefer to deploy after gateway so flags are stable.

Sophia Gomez: I got model-serving rollback readiness. Playbooks validated this morning and HSM keys ok.

Maria Chen: Thanks — small note: infra-db-migration planned for 10:00-10:05 (low-risk). @infra-team please confirm no long locks.

deploy-bot: slot-reserve: inference-runtime reserved 10:15-10:45 PT for Alex Rivera. Link: https://deploys.internal/slot/3032104567

Raj Patel: Confirmed migrations are minor — single schema tweak, no backfill. We should still run `pg_dump` pre-step.

Alex Rivera: Copy. I'll run smoke script after infra and before canary redirect: `./smoke.sh --service inference-runtime --check-kv`

Maria Chen: Proposed deploy order (open to adjustments):
```
1) infra-db-migrations (10:00-10:05)
2) serving-runtime / inference-runtime (10:15-10:45 canary)
3) router + canary traffic shift (10:50-11:00)
4) api-gateway (11:00-11:20)
5) app-config & flags (11:25-11:35)
```

Jordan Lee: Ok with that order. If gateway slips, we'll push app-config by 15m.

Sophia Gomez: Rollback checklist for model-serving: (1) revert model tag, (2) restore KV cache snapshot, (3) switch traffic. Tested last week.

Maria Chen: Two asks: 1) All PRs into `release/wed` by Tue EOD. 2) Smoke owners, please paste the smoke command you'll run here.

Alex Rivera: Smoke command: `git checkout release/wed && ./deploy.sh inference-runtime --smoke`

Raj Patel: I'll run `curl -sS https://staging/api/healthz | jq .` as part of gateway smoke and run a few auth flows.

Jordan Lee: App-config smoke: `./flag-checker --env=staging --validate`

Maria Chen: Any objections to a 2-min gap between canary redirect and full shift? Want to watch metrics.

Alex Rivera: +1 to 2-min gap. I'll monitor latency and error-rate dashboards.

Raj Patel: Fine. I'll be on call at 11:00 for gateway.

Sophia Gomez: Also, if anyone changes quantization profiles for model-serving, ping me — I need to validate perf regressions.

Maria Chen: Final housekeeping: please update runbook with who is smoke owner and rollback contact. I'll compile and post a single checklist tomorrow morning.

Alex Rivera: Got it — I'll add my smoke notes to the runbook. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: Adding gateway smoke steps now.

Jordan Lee: Will add feature flag rollback snippet.

deploy-bot: Reminder set: release-train-check 09:50 PT on Wed.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — if you can't make your slot DM me and ping @releases. Otherwise assume assigned.
